description_en: Revokes the permissions that are granted to an Alibaba Cloud Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 取消指定阿里云子账号的权限
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 revoke-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffcdf01 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id test.defalutGroup --user-id 277641081920123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokePermission

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier (UID) of the namespace. You can obtain the namespace UID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间UID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_id
